test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate phrase for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The judgment was __rejected__ by the Chief Justice.
solution:
The correct answer is Set aside.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word 'rejected' means 'dismissed as inadequate, unacceptable, or faulty'.
 
• Let's consider each option-
 
 
• Seen through- Not be deceived by someone or something; detect the true nature of someone or something.
 
• Stand out- Be clearly better or more significant than someone or something.
 
• Set aside- To decide not to consider something. 
 
• Run in- Be common or inherent in members of a family, especially over several generations.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate phrase for the word 'rejected' is 'set aside'.
 
• Thus option 3 is the correct answer.

Correct sentence: The judgment was set aside by the Chief Justice.
